persona: Man managing fourteen agentic chats sharing one loaded model

B01.reason: Remove repetition while retaining concise global draft/saved/applied facts.

B02.reason: Automatic/Custom batch summary preserves operational awareness without making a technical mechanism a peer decision.

B03.reason: Reading and answer throughput support long-prompt work decisions; compact memory and scoped evidence prevent overclaiming.

B04.reason: A small action hierarchy preserves deliberate saving and reviewed restart while hiding infrequent actions.

B05.reason: Scope and application timing remain scannable; descriptions can expand deliberately.

B06.reason: Unique exact winners expose meaningful alternatives together without duplicate actions or tall cards.

B07.reason: Exact identity prevents wrong-variant switching and enables later evidence inspection.

B08.reason: Both rates fit one row and reveal whether a candidate favors prompt processing or answer generation.

B09.reason: Compact actionable no-fit and shared-winner states reclaim space without implying approval.

B10.reason: Installed-first supports repeated model management; remembered deliberate choice retains discovery access.

B11.reason: Aligned rows show throughput, memory blockers and evidence differences without three repeated panels.

B12.reason: Optional tuning can live inside explicit pre-download review; a mandatory separate tuning stop adds navigation.

B13.reason: Short descriptors clarify established profile names without changing an operator's vocabulary across surfaces.

B14.reason: Compact actual fit/download review retains commitment facts and expands invalid retained settings.

B15.reason: Actual stage and local recovery are useful; duplicated progress text is not.

B16.reason: Ready should confirm loaded identity and offer chat, with repeated breakdown and demo test optional.

B17.reason: Relevant known activity and consistent lifecycle checks protect shared work without idle queue chrome.

B18.reason: Scoped shared source labels remove duplication while retaining mixed and unknown evidence locally.

B19.reason: A short actual capability-review status helps distinguish tool evidence from high reading throughput.

B20.reason: Exact text-sample sizes preserve throughput context without suggesting document or tool capability.

amendments: B17: compact global state is enough at idle; show known activity when busy or before consequential actions. Do not equate open chats with concurrent requests or invent counts, queue positions or wait ETAs.
B17: lifecycle checks should account for known chat streaming and serving active/queued work consistently; absent telemetry is unknown, not zero.
B06/B09: merge only identical exact variants with identical proposed execution settings; different context/batch/cache/placement/threads are different setups even if downloads are shared.
B03/B08/B11: keep a short visible per-request qualifier near rates or their group: queue wait and reasoning are unknown. No aggregate fourteen-chat completion estimate.
B12: optional Tune still requires an explicit exact-variant, configuration, download and fit review before preparation; expand controls on invalid retained choices.
B19: show literal available review metadata or pending status, never infer approved tool quality, task safety or parallel capacity.
